items.markdown:
BTS will perform in Bangkok for three nights on **December 3, 5, and 6, 2026** as part of their [BTS World Tour 'ARIRANG'](https://btsworldtourofficial.com/) at the [Rajamangala National Stadium](https://www.jambase.com/show/the-weeknd-rajamangala-stadium-20261013).[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/p/DbIxF6EtuyT/)[[2]](https://www.traveloka.com/en-en/explore/activities/how-to-get-to-rajamangala-national-stadium/1008412)

Concert Details

- **Dates:** December 3, December 5, and December 6, 2026
- **Venue:** Rajamangala National Stadium (286 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 24 Yaek 18, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok)
- **Show Time:** 7:00 PM local time
- **Tour Organizer:** [Live Nation](https://www.livenation.com/event/intl_1675488/bts-world-tour-arirang-in-bangkok) [[1]](https://www.jambase.com/show/the-weeknd-rajamangala-stadium-20261013)[[2]](https://www.shazam.com/event/ab8a004b-a34e-46f2-86ac-23feedee8de3)[[3]](https://www.livenation.com/event/intl_1675488/bts-world-tour-arirang-in-bangkok)

Travel and Logistics Tips

- **Getting There:** The stadium is located in the Bang Kapi area, which can experience heavy traffic during major events. Consider using public transit options like the Airport Rail Link (Ramkhamhaeng Station) combined with a taxi, boat service via the Saen Saep Canal, or shuttle buses from nearby main roads.[](https://www.traveloka.com/en-en/explore/activities/how-to-get-to-rajamangala-national-stadium/1008412) [[1]](https://us.trip.com/travel-guide/trip-events/156358122?locale=%7Blang%7D&allianceid=1076145&sid=4330723&s-productIdTop=110419161&source=%7Bsurface%7D&curr=%7Bcurrency%7D&funnel=%7Bfunnel%7D&adsource=%7BGOOGLE-ADS-CLICK-SOURCE%7D&s-googlever=MjYwNzI1LjA4MDAwMC4xMC4xMjUuMTkzLjE0NC4xMTYuMTk5MTA3OTM0XzY=)
- **Accommodation:** Booking a hotel near Ramkhamhaeng Road, Rama IX, or Sukhumvit line with easy transit connections to the east side of the city will help reduce travel time on concert days.
